shared_elements: human figures in profile with long hair and beards
shallow relief carving of figures with muscular limbs
incised parallel-line patterning (hair, mane, feather/fringe detail)
rosette-like circular motifs (whorls/discs in A, flower discs in B)
frieze-like field filled edge to edge
justification: Both depict bearded profile human figures in shallow relief with the same conventions of dense incised parallel lines for hair, beards, fringes and animal manes, plus small rosette/whorl discs used as filler ornament, which suggests shared carving conventions. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A is a chaotic narrative scene of a chariot, horses, wheels and sprawling bodies in a watery field, while B is a static symmetrical composition of large winged figures flanking a central stylised plant/tree above a band of writing.
